assertion_audit.fails_if: The snapshot callback is reached outside the real transition publication context.
Initial publication occurs before seat acquisition or after unlock.
The original RuntimeError/SystemExit is swallowed, converted, or replaced; comparing the injected exception identity tests propagation, and is not credited as exit-receipt coverage.
The snapshot publication hook is skipped or invoked repeatedly.
The context yields despite the initial publication failure.
Seat teardown is skipped, repeated, or happens after the seat is already unlocked.
The lifecycle guard is moved back outside _project_watch_claim; actual revert-control log reports this exact assertion failing twice.
RuntimeError no longer maps to 1 or SystemExit(75) loses its code; status is the independent expected mapping, never supplied to the recorder.
The publication stage marker is absent or reset before recording the exception.
The receipt uses a predecessor or wrong process identity rather than the executing process.

The recorder drops or misformats the thrown exception class/message; this expectation is derived from the injected error, but compares against a separately read durable receipt and can fail when formatting changes.
The exit receipt captured before unlock is erased or changed after release; comparing two disk observations is a persistence assertion, not an independent status-mapping assertion.
Seat release fails and leaves the lock held.
The claim is not acquired in the isolated crew home.
The added _write_watch_record(handle, record) is removed and the seat lacks the lifecycle keys present in the yielded watcher; the pre-repair reproduction reports this mismatch.
Both seat and watcher agree on a missing or wrong last_stage, closing the co-moving weakness of equality alone.
Both seat and watcher agree on missing, null or non-positive started_at_epoch.

failure_delta_evidence.note: These are the manifest baseline_suite and after_suite; the broader importer comparison is separately reported below and is not collapsed into this scoped delta.

0.reason: coordinator disposition: the four disputed importer ids are pre-existing flakes, not added failures; across five base/head trial pairs they failed 12 times at base de83f451 and 9 at head 72ae697a, every one also failing at base (importer-baseline-attribution.json)

findings.text: blocking: The live section and source done_when require no added failures among watch_unit/runs importers, but the completed broader comparison has four added failure IDs still unadjudicated; the clean 58-to-71-test scoped pair does not establish that separate condition, so coordinator disposition or a qualifying repair and comparison is required before landing.
